PostToolUse.command: if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '/frontend/.*\.(vue|ts|js|css)$'; then cd frontend && npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi

if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '/frontend/.*\.(vue|ts)$'; then cd frontend && timeout 60 npx vue-tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc-hook.tsbuildinfo 2>&1 | head -30; fi
PostToolUse.description: [TypeCheck] Incremental vue-tsc for .vue/.ts files (timeout 60s, first 30 error lines)

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '/backend/.*\.java$'; then cd backend && mvn compile -q 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
PostToolUse.description: [Compile] mvn compile check for .java files (quiet mode, last 20 lines)

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|vue)$'; then if grep -qn 'console\.log' "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo '[HOOK] ⚠ console.log found — remove before commit' >&2; fi; fi; true
PostToolUse.description: [Lint] Warn if console.log found in .ts/.vue files (never blocks)

PreToolUse.command: if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.java$'; then node -e "const c=[];process.stdin.on('data',d=>c.push(d));process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const r=Buffer.concat(c).toString();const j=JSON.parse(r);const n=(j.tool_input?.content||'').split('\n').length;if(n>800)process.stderr.write('[HOOK] ⚠ Java file exceeds 800 lines ('+n+'), consider splitting\n');process.stdout.write(r);});else cat; fi
PreToolUse.description: [SizeGuard] Warn if Java file exceeds 800 lines (soft warning, never blocks, non-Java pass through)

Stop.description: [Test] Run backend unit tests at session end

Stop.command: cd frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; true
Stop.description: [TypeCheck] Full frontend type-check at session end (informational)
